sidebarTagline: A few quick steps to get your farm running.

welcome.title: Welcome to FarmOS
welcome.desc: Let's get your farm set up. You'll create your farm, an active season, your first field and its crop — the rest is optional and can be added later. Most farmers finish this in under 5 minutes.

farm.title: Your farm
farm.desc: Basic details, plus location if you have it — you can add coordinates later.
farm.alreadySaved: Your farm details are already saved.
farm.coordsHint: No coordinates? No problem — continue without them. The Weather page will explain they're missing and let you add them later.

season.title: Active season
season.desc: FarmOS organises everything by season. Create the current one.
season.alreadySaved: Your active season is already set up.

field.title: Your first field
field.desc: Add one field to get started — you can add more any time from the Fields page.
field.alreadyAdded: Your first field is already added. You can add more any time from the Fields page.

crop.title: What's growing there?
crop.desc: Assign a crop to the field for this season.
crop.alreadyAssigned: A crop is already assigned for this season. You can add more fields any time from the Activities page.

inventory.title: Add your first product? (optional)
inventory.desc: Basic details take under 30 seconds — advanced fields are optional.

employee.title: Add an operator? (optional)
employee.desc: Record the farm owner, machine operator, or spray operator. Certificate details are stored as entered for your own records — not verified against any registry.
employee.name: Name

review.title: Review
review.desc: Everything below is already saved. Finish to go to your dashboard.

complete.title: You're all set
complete.desc: Your farm is ready. You can add more fields, products, and operators any time from their pages.
